change_kind.description: what the change is; a bugfix must reproduce its regression with a failing test before the implementation is edited, and its regression test must fail on its first run, before the implementation is first changed

risk.description: how much proof the change must carry; each level applies every obligation of the level below it and one more

nodes.description: change the implementation in the repository's working revision; a bugfix needs its regression reproduced first
nodes.name: implementation.edit

nodes.description: return to a previous release; needs authority to roll back, and invoking it earns no outcome until a rollback result says it is complete
nodes.name: release.rollback

nodes.description: read the repository
nodes.name: repository.inspect

nodes.description: merge a revision into the repository's mainline; needs the current implementation revision verified and authority to merge, never only a connection to the repository host
nodes.name: repository.merge

nodes.description: run the tests against an implementation revision
nodes.name: tests.run

nodes.description: change the tests in the repository's working revision
nodes.name: tests.write

nodes.description: the record of how a release was built from an implementation
nodes.name: build_provenance

nodes.description: a review of an implementation revision; its result is approved or rejected
nodes.name: code_review

nodes.description: the record that the implementation was changed, moving it to a new revision
nodes.name: implementation_change

nodes.description: an observation of whether the intent's objective is met; its result is satisfied or unsatisfied
nodes.name: objective_observation

nodes.description: an observation of the running system; its result is healthy or unhealthy
nodes.name: operational_observation

nodes.description: the result of running a bugfix's regression test against an implementation revision; its result is pass or fail
nodes.name: regression_test_result

nodes.description: the result of returning a release to the one before it; its result is complete or partial
nodes.name: rollback_result

nodes.description: the result of running tests against an implementation revision; its result is pass or fail
nodes.name: test_result

nodes.description: the deployment is running healthily
nodes.name: deployment.healthy

nodes.description: the current implementation revision is reviewed
nodes.name: implementation.reviewed

nodes.description: the current implementation revision is verified
nodes.name: implementation.verified

nodes.description: the intent's objective is met
nodes.name: objective.realized

nodes.description: the regression a bugfix repairs is reproduced: a test has failed on the current implementation revision, or the first run of the regression test, on any revision of the implementation, failed
nodes.name: regression.reproduced

nodes.description: the regression test failed first, before the implementation was first changed: the first regression test result about the implementation failed, and it was observed before the implementation's first change
nodes.name: regression.shown_first

nodes.description: the current implementation revision is verified and the current release revision carries build provenance; nothing here ties that release to the verified implementation revision
nodes.name: release.proven

nodes.description: the tests pass for the current implementation revision
nodes.name: tests.pass

nodes.description: the case closed because the change was explicitly abandoned without reaching any planned outcome
nodes.name: abandoned

nodes.description: the case closed with its result accepted; needs the release proven, the deployment healthy and the objective realized
nodes.name: accepted

nodes.description: the case closed because the change was explicitly declined; needs no implementation
nodes.name: declined

nodes.description: the case closed with its release rolled back; needs a rollback result about the current release revision that says the rollback is complete
nodes.name: rolled_back

nodes.description: the case closed because another change explicitly superseded it
nodes.name: superseded

nodes.description: the deployment is healthy; applies at critical risk
nodes.name: health.required

nodes.description: the release is proven; applies at elevated risk and above
nodes.name: provenance.required

nodes.description: the regression test failed on its first run, before the implementation was first changed; applies to a bugfix, at every risk
nodes.name: red_first.required

nodes.description: the current implementation revision is reviewed; applies at standard risk and above
nodes.name: review.required

nodes.description: the tests pass for the current implementation revision; applies at every risk
nodes.name: tests.required

protocol.description: Deliver a change to a software system: implement it, verify the current implementation revision, merge it under authority, release and deploy it, and accept it once its objective is realized; or close it declined, superseded or abandoned on an explicit decision, or rolled back on a complete rollback result. A case fixes its risk, which selects the obligations that apply, and its change kind, which selects whether a regression must be reproduced before the implementation is edited, and whether its regression test must fail on its first run, before the implementation is first changed.
